name: Haus Christine
beschreibung:
Sunnily and quietly situated in Tannheim, Haus Christine welcomes visitors with comfortable apartments offering breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks. It is an ideal alpine base in all seasons.

The Vogelhorn cable car, Lake Vilsalpsee, and cross-country ski trails are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Christine in Tannheim provides cosy holiday apartments in the scenic Tannheimer Tal valley.
